training_patterns.mechanism: Downweight already well-classified examples in a binary outcome loss.
training_patterns.when_to_try: A rare outcome is underfit on supported slices while plain binary cross-entropy is dominated by easy examples.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Outcome prevalence, per-class and calibration metrics, and the same observed label definition.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep model, rows, optimizer budget and threshold rule fixed; compare binary cross-entropy with focal loss across gamma values chosen only on training/validation.
training_patterns.reject_if: Held-out primary metric or calibration degrades, or gain vanishes when class weighting is controlled.

training_patterns.mechanism: Train positive scores above sampled negative scores rather than fit each sampled label independently.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Pointwise training improves sampled classification but fixed-universe top-K ranking remains weak.
training_patterns.required_evidence: User-positive pairs, negative-sampling provenance, candidate universe and full or declared evaluation protocol.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use identical model, positives, negatives and compute budget; change only pointwise versus pairwise loss.
training_patterns.reject_if: Full-universe top-K gain is absent or depends on an incompatible negative sampler.

training_patterns.mechanism: Optimize a normalized distribution over a query or slate instead of independent item labels.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Per-item calibration is adequate but query-level ordering or slate utility is poor.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Complete candidate groups, group-level labels, exposure rules and a fixed group metric.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep candidate groups, backbone, labels and training budget fixed; compare pointwise and listwise objectives.
training_patterns.reject_if: Group metric does not improve or missing candidates make the normalization misleading.

training_patterns.mechanism: Change relative task-loss weights while keeping shared architecture fixed.
training_patterns.when_to_try: One outcome improves while the declared primary outcome or guardrail regresses.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Task label coverage, scale and missingness, primary metric and guardrails.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Freeze inputs, task heads and split; compare fixed equal weights with one prespecified weighting rule.
training_patterns.reject_if: Primary objective or required guardrail regresses, or weights exploit label missingness.

training_patterns.mechanism: Mine confusable exposed non-clicked items while mixing random negatives and guarding against unobserved positives.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Random negatives are trivially separated but recall on exposed, similar items remains low.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Time-safe exposure logs, item catalog, sampler probabilities and false-negative risk by popularity slice.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep tower, positive events, batch size, total negatives and evaluation universe fixed; vary only hard-negative share.
training_patterns.reject_if: Full-catalog recall or coverage falls, false-negative contamination grows, or mining uses future interactions.

training_patterns.mechanism: Increase weight of difficult training rows using out-of-fold or lagged predictions rather than current-row label leakage.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Stable, sufficiently supported residual slices remain underfit after simpler architecture and loss tests.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Out-of-fold difficulty scores, slice support, outcome noise audit and effective sample-size report.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Fix model, rows and compute; compare uniform weights with capped hard-example weights under the same evaluator.
training_patterns.reject_if: Weighted fit overfits noisy labels, shrinks effective sample size excessively or worsens held-out slices.

training_patterns.mechanism: Rebalance training minibatches while accounting for changed class priors during calibration.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Rare-label recall is poor and each class has enough independent examples for resampling.
training_patterns.required_evidence: True label prevalence, unit-level duplication and calibration under the original validation distribution.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep examples, architecture and steps fixed; compare natural and rebalanced minibatches with the same original-distribution validation.
training_patterns.reject_if: Original-distribution utility or calibration degrades, or resampling duplicates units across splits.

training_patterns.mechanism: Change learning-rate trajectory without changing the model or objective.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Training curves indicate oscillation, premature plateau or sensitivity to a fixed learning rate.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Train and validation curves, optimizer state, matched updates and total compute budget.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep model, loss, seed set and update count fixed; compare constant rate with one prespecified schedule.
training_patterns.reject_if: Any apparent gain disappears at matched updates or increases run-to-run variance.

training_patterns.mechanism: Bound gradient norms to stabilize updates without changing features or network structure.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Recorded gradient norms spike alongside loss divergence or unstable seed outcomes.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Gradient-norm and loss traces plus a threshold chosen without final-holdout feedback.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep all settings fixed and compare clipped versus unclipped updates at matched steps.
training_patterns.reject_if: Training stability and held-out metric fail to improve, or clipping stalls learning.

training_patterns.mechanism: Penalize parameter magnitude while excluding parameters whose shrinkage would distort normalization or bias.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Training metric rises while validation metric and calibration worsen with model capacity.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Train-validation gap, parameter groups and fixed training budget.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use same architecture and updates; compare zero weight decay with one tuned on validation only.
training_patterns.reject_if: Both training and held-out utility fall or small cohorts degrade beyond guardrails.

training_patterns.mechanism: Randomly mask selected training inputs to reduce reliance on brittle fields.
training_patterns.when_to_try: One pre-decision feature group dominates predictions and its coverage or stability is uncertain.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Field-level attribution or ablation, missingness and serving-time availability.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep fields and model fixed; vary only training-time mask rate and evaluate original validation inputs.
training_patterns.reject_if: Primary metric drops or masking hides a genuine required signal.

training_patterns.mechanism: Fit a scalar temperature on a separate calibration split while freezing model logits.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Ranking is adequate but probability estimates or action thresholds are systematically miscalibrated.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Untouched calibration split, reliability curve, proper scoring rule and the fixed decision objective.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Freeze the trained predictor and compare raw versus temperature-scaled probabilities before any action-rule change.
training_patterns.reject_if: Calibration or downstream policy utility does not improve on validation, or calibration rows overlap model fitting.

training_patterns.mechanism: Create training-only history views by masking or truncating pre-decision events without changing labels.
training_patterns.when_to_try: Sequence models overfit sparse histories and valid shorter prefixes are common at serving time.
training_patterns.required_evidence: Event timestamps, decision cutoff, sequence-length distribution and a no-future-event audit.
training_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep architecture, rows and evaluation prefixes fixed; compare unaugmented and one time-safe augmentation rule.
training_patterns.reject_if: Prefix consistency or held-out utility worsens, or augmentation exposes future events.
